design_system.title: Design System
design_system.subtitle: Principles, tokens, and component rules for consistent NeX_PCX screens

principles.title: Design Principles
principles.subtitle: Decision rules for experiment and operations screens
principles.p1_body: Keep enough density for quick scanning of status, metrics, failures, and next actions.
principles.p2_body: Expose metadata that helps repeat searches, evaluations, and worker runs under the same conditions.
principles.p3_body: Explain excluded information with aggregate counts only, without hidden titles or previews.
principles.p4_body: Design for Korean by default while keeping English labels stable inside buttons, tables, and cards.

documentation.title: Documentation Rules
documentation.subtitle: Checks to repeat when adding new screens
documentation.d1_body: List screens should flow as header, filter, table, then optional detail.
documentation.d2_body: Avoid long in-app instructions and prefer short labels focused on state and outcomes.
documentation.d3_body: UI slices should use Playwright captures for Korean, English, and responsive layout checks.
